item.title: Talk Amongst Yourselves! On 217 acres in Virginia. $800,000
item.description: Talk amongst yourselves! I had high hopes for this listing! The red of the house, the setting, the acreage, I got excited to look inside. The first few interior pictures had me excited…..then I started looking closer. I understand the price is about the acreage, but geeze, that acreage sure is having to do a lot of the heavy lifting. item.title: Pretty setting with a creek! Tall ceilings! Five acres in Mississippi. $299,000
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! There is a large creek and multiple outbuildings! The house was built in 1898. It is located on five acres in Seminary, Mississippi. I would undo some of the DIY stuff, but the house could easily be worked room by room! The house features a covered front porch, large entry hall, wood floors, chair rails, tall ceilings, picture rails, wide baseboards, big rooms, brick fireplace, built-in bookshelves, spacious kitchen and a large back patio. item.title: 1860 cottage in Mississippi. Nice details! $110,000
item.description: This antebellum cottage has a lot of potential! There are nice tall ceilings inside. The cottage was built in 1860. It is located in Vicksburg, Mississippi. The house features a covered front porch, tall ceilings, wood floors, chair rails, crown moulding, ceiling medallion and a pretty chandelier. Within walking distance to downtown restaurants and shopping. item.title: Wow! $174,900! Old Schoolhouse on the Hill! Over an acre in Missouri.
item.description: Wow! How about that price! This was an old schoolhouse. It is known as the Old Schoolhouse on the Hill. It was built in 1876. It is located on 1.14 acres in Chamois, Missouri. The house features wood floors, bead board wainscoting, baseboards and tall ceilings. Wish there were more pictures. item.title: Pretty woodwork! Great kitchen sink! Circa 1890 in New York. $300,000
item.description: This house has really pretty woodwork! Love the staircase! I want the kitchen sink! The house was built in 1890. It is located in Rochester, New York. The house features a large covered front porch, pretty staircase with built-in seating, original wood floors, baseboards, built-in bookshelves, spacious rooms, pocket doors, great kitchen sink and a second staircase. There is a large basement. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,726 square feet. $300,000 Contact Dayna Orione-Kim with Keller Willia

item.title: Porch goals! Almost four acres in North Carolina. $450,000
item.description: Porch goals! What a great porch this is! The house is nice and there are outbuildings. The house was built in 1907. It is located on 3.77 acres in Bunnlevel, North Carolina. The house features a large wrap around front porch, original wood floors, crown moulding, wide baseboards, tall ceilings, chair rails, spacious kitchen, wainscoting and a claw foot tub. item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Not bad for $59,000! C. 1922 in Virginia.
item.description: This fixer upper has some nice potential! Especially at that price. Could live there and work room by room. The house was built in 1922. It is located on .46 acre in Clifton Forge, Virginia. The house features an enclosed front porch, wood floors, baseboards, basement, sunroom and a decent sized kitchen. item.title: A lot of house for the money! Love the sunroom! 6,000 square feet in Ohio. $625,000
item.description: This sure is a lot of house for the money! I am in love with that sunroom! The house was built in 1928. It is located on 1.22 acres in Akron, Ohio. The house features a grand foyer, pretty staircase, wood floors, custom drapes, baseboards, crown moulding, beautiful sunroom with vintage chandelier, really spacious kitchen, wainscoting, office with built-in bookshelves and a finished basement. item.description: The pool looks nice! This mid-century has nice details! The house was built in 1953. It is located on 1.12 acres in Lawton, Oklahoma.
